scenarios.name: unused-local-variable
scenarios.why: Highlighting the entire declaration or other variables misleads the developer about which variable is unreferenced.

scenarios.name: multiple-unused-locals-same-line
scenarios.why: Highlighting the full line fails to identify which individual variables in the comma-separated list are unused.

scenarios.name: unknown-type-variable-declaration
scenarios.why: Highlighting the variable name or the full statement obscures that the type specifier itself is unresolved.

scenarios.name: unknown-type-parameter
scenarios.why: Highlighting the parameter name or function signature conceals that the parameter type is unrecognized.

scenarios.name: unknown-type-return-type
scenarios.why: Highlighting the function name or whole signature obscures that only the return type is unresolved.

scenarios.name: duplicate-local-declaration
scenarios.why: Highlighting the original declaration or the whole line conceals which statement constitutes the invalid duplicate.

scenarios.name: local-duplicates-parameter
scenarios.why: Highlighting the parameter incorrectly blames the valid parameter definition rather than the colliding local variable.

scenarios.name: bare-return-in-non-void-function
scenarios.why: Highlighting the function signature forces the reader to manually search for which return statement lacks a value.

scenarios.name: return-value-in-constructor
scenarios.why: Highlighting the constructor declaration rather than the return statement obscures where the illegal return value is located.

scenarios.name: null-assigned-to-primitive
scenarios.why: The variable declaration itself is valid while null cannot be assigned to non-handles, so the diagnostic blames null.

scenarios.name: not-all-paths-return
scenarios.why: Highlighting the function body or closing brace provides poor visual clarity compared to flagging the function name directly.

scenarios.name: undeclared-identifier-expression
scenarios.why: Highlighting the entire assignment or line obscures exactly which identifier was not found.

scenarios.name: undeclared-function-call
scenarios.why: Highlighting parentheses or call arguments implies a syntax or argument error rather than an unknown callee name.
